title: Disney Sidekicks & Animals
description: The supporting cast — pets, animals, comic relief, and best friends.

questions.prompt: What kind of animal is Pumbaa in The Lion King?
questions.explanation: Pumbaa is voiced by Ernie Sabella; his name means 'simpleton' or 'careless' in Swahili, fitting his easygoing nature.

questions.prompt: What kind of animal is Timon in The Lion King?
questions.explanation: Timon is voiced by Nathan Lane and was the first Disney character whose entire body was animated, not just the face.

questions.prompt: What kind of bird is Zazu in The Lion King?
questions.explanation: Zazu is a red-billed hornbill who serves as Mufasa's majordomo; he's voiced by Rowan Atkinson in the 1994 original.

questions.prompt: What kind of animal is Rafiki in The Lion King?
questions.explanation: Rafiki is technically a mandrill with a baboon's tail; 'rafiki' means 'friend' in Swahili and he serves as the kingdom's shaman.

questions.prompt: Name any one of the three good fairies in Sleeping Beauty.
questions.explanation: The three fairies are Flora (red), Fauna (green), and Merryweather (blue); they raise Aurora as 'Briar Rose' in the woods.

questions.prompt: Name any one of the Seven Dwarfs.
questions.explanation: The seven are Doc, Grumpy, Happy, Sleepy, Bashful, Sneezy, and Dopey — from the first feature-length animated film, Snow White (1937).

questions.prompt: Which dwarf in Snow White never speaks?
questions.explanation: Dopey is silent because the team couldn't find the right voice; the studio later said he simply 'never tried' to speak.

questions.prompt: What are the names of the two adult Dalmatian parents in 101 Dalmatians?
questions.explanation: Pongo and Perdita have 15 puppies of their own and rescue 84 more from Cruella de Vil in the 1961 animated classic.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the alley cat who helps the Aristocats?
questions.explanation: Thomas O'Malley is the streetwise orange tomcat voiced by Phil Harris, who also voiced Baloo in The Jungle Book.

questions.prompt: Who is Robin Hood's bear best friend in the 1973 Disney film?
questions.explanation: Little John is voiced by Phil Harris and his character design was reused — he's essentially Baloo from The Jungle Book in a new outfit.

questions.prompt: What are the names of the two mice agents in The Rescuers?
questions.explanation: Bernard (Bob Newhart) and Miss Bianca (Eva Gabor) work for the Rescue Aid Society in this 1977 film and its 1990 Australian sequel.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the teapot in Beauty and the Beast?
questions.explanation: Mrs. Potts is voiced by Angela Lansbury, who recorded the title song 'Beauty and the Beast' in a single take.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the teacup, son of Mrs. Potts?
questions.explanation: Chip has a chip on the rim of his cup and was originally meant to have just one line; the team expanded his role after liking the voice.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the mantel clock in Beauty and the Beast?
questions.explanation: Cogsworth is the uptight head of household voiced by David Ogden Stiers, who also voiced the narrator and the villain Governor Ratcliffe.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Aladdin's pet monkey?
questions.explanation: Abu is a capuchin monkey who wears a fez and vest; he's a skilled pickpocket and is briefly turned into an elephant by Genie.

questions.prompt: What kind of animal is Pocahontas's companion Percy?
questions.explanation: Percy is Governor Ratcliffe's pampered pug who eventually defects to Pocahontas's side after meeting Meeko the raccoon.

questions.prompt: What kind of bird is Pocahontas's companion Flit?
questions.explanation: Flit is a ruby-throated hummingbird whose rapid wing-beats let animators show his suspicion of John Smith through hovering close-ups.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Hercules's satyr trainer?
questions.explanation: Philoctetes is voiced by Danny DeVito; in Greek myth he was a famed archer, but Disney reimagined him as a grumpy hero-trainer.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Mulan's lucky cricket?
questions.explanation: Cri-Kee was given to Mulan by her grandmother as a good-luck charm; in Chinese culture, crickets are traditional symbols of luck.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the alien scientist who created Stitch?
questions.explanation: Dr. Jumba Jookiba is voiced by David Ogden Stiers; Stitch is officially his 626th genetic experiment, designed for destruction.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Jumba's one-eyed partner in Lilo & Stitch?
questions.explanation: Pleakley is the nervous Galactic Federation agent voiced by Kevin McDonald, who's obsessed with Earth and loves wearing human dresses.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the cat who befriends Bolt on his journey home?
questions.explanation: Mittens is a streetwise declawed cat voiced by Susie Essman in Bolt (2008), John Travolta's first animated voice role.

questions.prompt: What kind of animal is Rhino, Bolt's biggest fan?
questions.explanation: Rhino is the obsessed hamster who lives in a plastic ball and worships Bolt; he was originally written as a much smaller part.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the glitch racer Ralph befriends in Wreck-It Ralph?
questions.explanation: Vanellope von Schweetz is voiced by Sarah Silverman; her glitch is actually a sign she's the rightful princess of Sugar Rush.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the mouse detective who solves cases on Baker Street?
questions.explanation: Basil of Baker Street stars in The Great Mouse Detective (1986), a Sherlock Holmes parody where the villain Ratigan is voiced by Vincent Price.
